title: Stage 3: Search, paging and statistics
summary: A paged, searchable catalogue and an author report, all computed by the database.

steps.title: A catalogue that scales
body: `GET /books` returns every book. With 40,000 books that is a 10 MB response and a slow page. This stage makes it a real catalogue:

Build the query in steps: start from `db.Books`, add the search `Where` only when a search was given, **count** the matches (one `SELECT COUNT(*)`), then sort, page and project (one `SELECT ... LIMIT ... OFFSET`). Two commands, whatever the size of the table.
Optional query-string values bind to nullable parameters: `(string? search, int? page, int? pageSize, LibraryDb db)`.

steps.explain: Filter first, so both the count and the page see the same matches. Count before paging, because the total is of all matches, not of one page. Sort before `Skip`/`Take`.

steps.title: The catalogue
prompt: Keep everything from stage 2 and change `GET /books`:
- `GET /books?search=&page=&pageSize=` returns `{ total, page, pageSize, items }`, where `items` are `BookRow`s ordered by title, then id.
- `page` defaults to 1 (values below 1 count as 1); `pageSize` defaults to 10 and is clamped to 1..50.
- `search` (optional) matches, ignoring case, books whose **title or author's name** contains it.
- Exactly two queries: a count and a page.

- `GET /stats/authors`: `[{ author, books, newest }]` for every author, ordered by number of books (most first), then name; `newest` is the year of their newest book, or `null` when they have none. One query: use `(int?)b.Year` inside `Max` so an author without books gives `null` instead of an error.

static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("searching and paging", async () =>
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Ursula K. Le Guin" });
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Frank Herbert" });
await Post(http, "/authors", new { name = "Nobody Yet" });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Earthsea", isbn = "9780441013593", year = 1968, authorId = 1 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "The Dispossessed", isbn = "9780547773742", year = 1974, authorId = 1 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Dune", isbn = "9780061054884", year = 1965, authorId = 2 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "Children of Dune", isbn = "9780441104024", year = 1976, authorId = 2 });
await Post(http, "/books", new { title = "The Lathe of Heaven", isbn = "9780743276405", year = 1971, authorId = 1 });
var dojoP1 = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?pageSize=2"));
Dojo.Eq("total counts every match", "5", DojoWeb.Prop(dojoP1, "total"));
Dojo.Eq("page 1 of 2, by title", "Children of Dune|Dune", Each(Field(dojoP1, "items"), "title"));
Dojo.Eq("items carry the author", "Frank Herbert|Frank Herbert", Each(Field(dojoP1, "items"), "author"));
var dojoP3 = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?page=3&pageSize=2"));
Dojo.Eq("page 3 of 2", "The Lathe of Heaven", Each(Field(dojoP3, "items"), "title"));
var dojoDefault = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books"));
Dojo.Eq("the default page is 1 of 10", "1 10 5", $"{DojoWeb.Prop(dojoDefault, "page")} {DojoWeb.Prop(dojoDefault, "pageSize")} {Field(dojoDefault, "items").GetArrayLength()}");
Dojo.Eq("pageSize is capped at 50", "50", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?pageSize=500")), "pageSize"));
var dojoDune = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?search=DUNE"));
Dojo.Eq("search matches titles, ignoring case", "2 Children of Dune|Dune", DojoWeb.Prop(dojoDune, "total") + " " + Each(Field(dojoDune, "items"), "title"));
var dojoLeGuin = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books?search=le%20guin&pageSize=2"));
Dojo.Eq("search matches author names too", "3 Earthsea|The Dispossessed", DojoWeb.Prop(dojoLeGuin, "total") + " " + Each(Field(dojoLeGuin, "items"), "title"));
var dojoStats = await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/stats/authors"));
Dojo.Eq("GET /stats/authors: most books first", "Ursula K. Le Guin|Frank Herbert|Nobody Yet", Each(dojoStats, "author"));
Dojo.Eq("...with counts", "3|2|0", Each(dojoStats, "books"));
Dojo.Eq("...and the newest year (null without books)", "1974|1976|null", Each(dojoStats, "newest"));
Dojo.Eq("GET /books/3 still works", "Dune", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await http.GetAsync("/books/3")), "title"));
static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> Post(HttpClient http, string url, object body) => await http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body);
static async Task<string?> Id(HttpResponseMessage r) => DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "id");
static string Each(JsonElement json, string prop) =>
json.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array ? string.Join("|", json.EnumerateArray().Select(x => DojoWeb.Prop(x, prop))) : "(not an array)";
static JsonElement Field(JsonElement json, string name)
if (json.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return default;
foreach (var p in json.EnumerateObject()) if (string.Equals(p.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return p.Value;
return default;
